global_rules: Deny by default: every non-public route declares exactly one catalogue capability scope and is guard-tested.
Approval separation: the requester/creator of a document can never decide its approval (all approval-required documents).
Tenant roles may contain only assignable tenant scopes; platform-only/service-only scopes are never granted by tenant roles.
Role/permission changes are effective immediately (scopes resolved per request); membership suspension/revocation bumps token_version and revokes sessions.
SoD-conflicting scope pairs cannot coexist in a non-admin template or a custom role; the admin break-glass template is exempt but audited.
The last active tenant administrator cannot be suspended, deactivated or have the admin role removed (lockout guard).
